data.name: Abqar
data.gender_notes: Abqar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A man of intelligence and wisdom, one who is deeply learned and knowledgeable. The name Abqar carries the meaning “Intelligent, Wise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Abqar usually hope their child will grow to embody intelligent, wise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name inspired by the divine wisdom and knowledge of Allah, bestowed upon a child to guide him towards the path of righteousness and knowledge.
data.etymology: Abqar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Intelligent, Wise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abqar total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.long_meaning: أبقر هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه المتقدم في العلم والمعرفة، صاحب الفضل والكرم، يتصف بالذكاء والفطنة. ورد في بعض الآثار أن اسم أبقر كان يطلق على أحد الصحابة رضي الله عنهم، ويعني الشخص الذي يتميز بالعلم الكثير والفضل الوفير.

in_urdu.name: ابقر
in_urdu.meaning: علم اور معرفت میں سبقت لینے والا، کرم و فضل کا مالک
in_urdu.long_meaning: ابقر ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی मूल سے ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے علم اور معرفت میں سبقت لینے والا، کرم و فضل کا مالک۔ یہ نام ذہانت اور فطرت کی خوبی کے لئے بھی استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ بعض تاریخی روایات کے مطابق، ابقر نام ایک صحابی رضی اللہ عنہ کا تھا، جو علم اور فضل کے لئے مشہور تھے۔

in_english.name: Abqar
in_english.meaning: One who excels in knowledge and wisdom, a possessor of virtue and generosity
in_english.long_meaning: Abqar is a masculine name of Arabic origin, signifying one who excels in knowledge and wisdom, a possessor of virtue and generosity. The name connotes intelligence, natural aptitude, and spiritual insight. Historically, Abqar was the name of a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), known for his extensive knowledge and virtuous character. In Islamic tradition, the name Abqar symbolizes the pursuit of knowledge, moral excellence, and charitable deeds.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Abqar" is deeply rooted in the rich Islamic culture and history. It is a name that signifies intelligence, wisdom, and knowledge. In many Arab and Islamic societies, having a name that denotes wisdom and intellect is highly esteemed and valued. The name "Abqar" is a reminder of the importance of education and knowledge in the Islamic tradition. It is a name that resonates with the proud legacy of Islamic scholarship and intellectual pursuit.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Abqar" holds great significance. It is a reminder of the importance of knowledge in seeking closeness to Allah. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "The man who goes to bed each night having learned something new, and wakes up each morning having put it into practice, will live long in this world and enter Paradise in the Hereafter." (Bukhari and Muslim) The name "Abqar" is an encouragement to seek knowledge, put it into practice, and constantly strive towards spiritual growth and development. It is a reminder that knowledge is a valuable tool in our journey towards Allah, and that a deep understanding of the Quran and the Sunnah is essential for living a blessed and fulfilling life.
